disease_label_per_paper: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction due to anti-Dia antibody
presentation_summary: 75-year-old woman undergoing staged total knee replacement; prior preoperative antibody screen and crossmatch were negative.
Packed RBC transfusion was started intraoperatively after blood loss greater than 800 mL.
Five minutes after one unit of packed RBCs had been transfused, red-colored urine suspicious for hemoglobinuria was observed while vital signs remained stable.
Urinalysis after the reaction showed 3+ blood, 0 RBC/HPF, and 2+ protein; post-operative hemoglobin was 8.7 g/dL and BUN/creatinine remained normal.
Independent blood center testing later identified anti-Dia antibody; this final blood bank result is confirmatory and non-ranking for presentation mode.
